_readme: JoJo's Blocks — CATEGORY TAXONOMY (future-ready structure). The full category tree for the digital-products platform: top categories and their subcategories, each with a status. 'live' means real content exists and the category is linked in the navigation; 'soon' means the structure is ready but no content exists yet — it must never be linked or published as an empty page. To activate a category: (1) create its content and data file (for example data/games.json for games, or a blog article file for the blog), (2) add its listing template, (3) set status to 'live' and give it an href in data/navigation.json, (4) re-run the generator, which validates that every live category's href points at a file it writes. Affiliate categories must always show a clear affiliate disclosure on any listing page. Blog articles use templates/blog-article.html. No paid PDF files are ever placed in public website folders.
